principles: Capability != Observable behavior != Failure mode != Measurement instrument != Evidence

capabilities.name: Problem Understanding
capabilities.definition: 正确解析题目文本、数据附件、隐含约束与交付要求
observable_behaviors: 能指认题面中每个数字/参数的来源和物理意义
能识别题面中的歧义点并显式标注
交付物格式要求被正确提取
capabilities.measurement_instrument: problem-parser (legacy, qualitative); planned: required_deliverables extraction hit rate

capabilities.name: Problem Alignment
capabilities.definition: 子问题分解覆盖率 + 题目要求到模型元素的强制映射
observable_behaviors: 产出的子问题列表覆盖题目全部子问
每个子问题能指认模型中承载它的变量/方程/约束
优化目标与题目要求一致

capabilities.name: Model Construction
capabilities.definition: 从问题到数学模型的完整构造：变量到参数到假设到目标到约束到机理到方程
observable_behaviors: 所有关键变量已声明并区分类型
所有参数已声明来源与取值
假设集显式合理可检验
目标函数明确且与题目一致
机理选择与问题物理一致

capabilities.name: Formal Consistency
capabilities.definition: 方程推导正确性、量纲一致、符号/索引/边界正确
observable_behaviors: 所有方程引用的参数已声明
capabilities.measurement_instrument: model_construction.py: mathematical dimension (error taxonomy); no automated checker yet

capabilities.name: Method Selection
capabilities.definition: 选择正确的模型家族和具体方法，独立于Problem Alignment
observable_behaviors: 选择的模型家族与题目gold family有交集
能区分方法名正确和方法适合问题
capabilities.measurement_instrument: e2e_metrics.py: method_selection (top-3 GT hit); FAMILY_MISMATCH binary check

capabilities.name: Solving
capabilities.definition: 选择合适的求解算法，处理可解性，代码执行确定性
observable_behaviors: 求解算法与模型类型匹配
求解步长与参数口径一致
结果在物理合理范围内
capabilities.measurement_instrument: e2e_metrics.py: experiment_validity; P14 replay match; solving strategy has no independent evaluator

capabilities.name: Validation
capabilities.definition: 模型验证充分性：对照基线、灵敏度分析、残差分析、交叉验证、极限检验
observable_behaviors: 验证目标与模型主张对应
capabilities.measurement_instrument: e2e_metrics.py: experiment_validity + validation_reliability; P14 Evidence-to-Claim chain

capabilities.name: Sensitivity-Robustness
capabilities.definition: 参数扰动下的结论稳定性、鲁棒性边界、不确定性传播
observable_behaviors: 有明确的灵敏度分析计划
不确定性从上游传播到下游
capabilities.measurement_instrument: e2e_metrics.py robustness tags (presence only); no independent quality score

capabilities.name: Evidence
capabilities.definition: 结果可追溯到已验证的实验，每个数值有明确来源
observable_behaviors: 每个数值可追溯到具体Execution artifact
随机种子固定，多seed有均值与标准差

capabilities.name: Claim Support
capabilities.definition: 每个结论/主张有可追溯的Evidence支持，区分supported/refuted/unresolved
capabilities.measurement_instrument: P14 p14_integrity_gate.py (Claim判定); e2e_metrics.py: validation_reliability; P15 FM-CS all empty (invalid)

capabilities.name: Communication
capabilities.definition: 模型构件到论文的结构传输、内容忠实度、无未授权变异
observable_behaviors: 模型构件在论文中有对应章节
capabilities.measurement_instrument: P13-3D STC v2 + Fidelity v2; r32_eval.py; Blind PQ
